penalties.authority: State Tax Officer, Group-III, Intelligence-II, Chennai-6.
penalties.details: Orders passed under Section 74 of the Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 for alleged ineligible claim/availment of Input Tax Credit (ITC), along with levy of interest under Section 50(3) and penalty under Section 74 of the Act.
penalties.impact: The financial implication comprises the tax, applicable interest and penalty amounts as specified in the respective Orders issued through Form GST DRC- 07 on the GST portal. Interest under Section 50(3) of the GST Act is payable at 18% per annum from the applicable due date until the actual date of payment and is required to be recomputed at the time of remittance. The financial implication comprises the tax, interest and penalty amounts as specified in the respective Orders issued by the State Tax Officer, Group-III, Intelligence-II, Chennai-6, through Form GST DRC-07 on the GST portal to the Company. There is no material impact on the financials, operations or other activities of the Company.

penalties.authority: Central Government Industrial Tribunal-cum-Labour Court, Chennai
penalties.details: The Tribunal, in EPFA No. 259 of 2017 [ATA No. 280(13)2013], has partly allowed the appeal filed against the order dated 1st April 2013 passed by the Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (PDC), Tambaram, whereby damages of ₹11,91,943/- under Section 14B and interest of ₹9,92,639/- under Section 7Q of the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 were determined for the period from November 1990 to March 2012. The Tribunal has directed that 50% of the damages assessed under Section 14B be waived and that the remaining 50% of the assessed damages be paid within three months from the date of the order.
penalties.impact: There is no material impact on the current financial position, operations or business activities of the Company.
